core_categories: Clinical Laboratory Testing; Diagnostic Services; Medical Informatics; Healthcare Equipment and Supplies; Food Hygiene Inspection; Dispensing Pharmacies
specialty_focus: BML, Inc. is a major Japanese clinical testing company providing contract laboratory testing, diagnostic services, and medical informatics to healthcare providers. It specializes in high-volume lab automation and offers over 4,000 diagnostic tests, with a focus on precision medicine areas such as oncology, infectious diseases, genetics, diabetes, and allergies. It does not appear to deal in wearable medical devices.
